The '''Dressellian Asteroid Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel system]]. In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], a group of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] explored the [[Star system/Legends|system]], but discovered that [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] was already [[Dressellian/Legends|inhabited]]. They settled in this asteroid belt instead. The system would remain out of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs until [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], when it was occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
